name: Officer's ~Onna Sousakan-tachi no Ingoku~
source:
Beautiful female police officers are imprisoned by the attack of tentacle monsters. 
Two female police officers goes to the underground mall to crack down on drug dealing, but it is a dirty trap a devil witch Angel set....

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE029715.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
美丽的女警察因触手怪物的袭击而被囚禁。
两名女警察前往地下商场打击毒品交易，却是魔女安琪设下的肮脏陷阱……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE029715.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
